headline: Mercado Libre Shares Fall 12% Following Q3 Results
summary: Mercado Libre shares dropped 12% on Wall Street after reporting third-quarter results. While net revenue grew 45% year-over-year to $10.75 billion, the company's operating margin contracted to 6.3%.
why: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce and fintech platform in Latin America; its earnings are a key indicator of regional consumer spending and digital adoption.

impacts.name: Mercado Libre
impacts.why: Market reaction to earnings miss or margin contraction.
